title: Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy deleted
description: Detects a successful Microsoft Entra audit operation that deletes a Conditional Access policy.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary or unauthorized administrator may delete a Conditional Access policy to weaken identity controls.
hypothesis.rationale: Microsoft recommends monitoring Conditional Access policy deletion because it can remove sign-in restrictions, but legitimate administrators also delete obsolete or replaced policies during approved changes.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify successful Conditional Access policy deletion events while leaving failed, update, creation and incomplete audit events unmatched.

triage.summary: Determine which policy was deleted, who initiated the change and whether an approved change record and replacement control exist.
steps: Review the initiating user or application, target policy, source IP, correlation identifier and surrounding audit operations.
Confirm the deletion against an approved change, the expected administrator and any intended replacement policy.
Inspect sign-ins and other identity-control changes after the deletion; restore protection and contain the initiating identity if unauthorized.
false_positives: Approved policy retirement, migration, emergency access and replacement changes performed by authorized identity administrators

validation.expected_outcome: Match successful Conditional Access policy deletion; do not match failed deletion, updates, creation or events without a result.
